purpose: Teach: 合図/当てる/早くから/年配/誉め/会わ/刺し/掛ける

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: スマホで友達からの合図、待ってる。
lines.en: I'm waiting for my friend to text me.
lines.style: Casual, present-tense immediacy. Light, slightly distracted — eyes on the phone. Natural teen cadence, no drama. Matter-of-fact warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 最近、当てる予測、外れまくり。
lines.en: My predictions have been totally off lately.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware laugh underneath. Rueful acceptance. Short pause after 'off' — lets the admission sit. Cool-distant on the surface, but genuinely bemused.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 朝早くから、塾、頑張ってる。
lines.en: I've been up early grinding through cram school.
lines.style: Quieter, slightly deflating. Tired undertone without complaining. Slow the pace slightly — acknowledging the effort it costs. Understated, almost to herself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 隣の年配のおじいちゃん、いつも挨拶してくれる。
lines.en: The old grandfather next door always says hello to me.
lines.style: Genuinely warm. Small smile in the voice. Noticing-someone-kind tone — not performing, just observing something good. Soft, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 担任が、提出物を誉めてくれた。
lines.en: My homeroom teacher complimented my assignment.
lines.style: Brighter energy now. Pride without bragging. Light lift on the word 'complimented' — letting herself feel good about it. Genuine happiness, not theatrical.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: まだ、転校生に会わずにいる。
lines.en: I still haven't met the transfer student yet.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly curious underneath. Measured pace. A touch of wondering — not anxiety, just noticing the absence. Quiet observation, like turning something over in her head.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 屋台でフランクフルト、串に刺して食べた。
lines.en: I got a frankfurter on a stick at the street stall.
lines.style: Lighter, more present-moment. Small delight in the memory. Natural, conversational — the tone of someone sharing something simple and good. Warmth without forcing it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 駅に着いたら、電話掛けるよ。
lines.en: I'll call you once I get to the station.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, reassuring. Casual close — not dramatic, just practical. Light, reliable tone. Sets a boundary gently and naturally.
